spec.expr: sum by (destination_service) (istio_requests_total{destination_service!="unknown"}) or sum by (destination_service) (istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_service!="unknown"}) or sum by (destination_service) (istio_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_service!="unknown"})

spec.query:
round(
  sum(irate(istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m])),
  0.001
)

(
        sum(
          irate(
            istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep",response_code!~"5.*"}[5m]
          )
        )
      /
        sum(irate(istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m]))
    )
  >
    -1
or on ()
  vector(1)

histogram_quantile(
      0.5,
      sum by (le) (
        irate(
          istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m]
        )
      )
    )
  /
    1000
or
  histogram_quantile(
    0.5,
    sum by (le) (
      irate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m])
    )
  )

histogram_quantile(
      0.9,
      sum by (le) (
        irate(
          istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m]
        )
      )
    )
  /
    1000
or
  histogram_quantile(
    0.9,
    sum by (le) (
      irate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m])
    )
  )

histogram_quantile(
      0.99,
      sum by (le) (
        irate(
          istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m]
        )
      )
    )
  /
    1000
or
  histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by (le) (
      irate(istio_request_duration_seconds_bucket{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[5m])
    )
  )
sum(irate(istio_tcp_received_bytes_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[1m]))

round(
  sum(irate(istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter="destination"}[5m])),
  0.001
)

(
        sum(
          irate(
            istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter="destination",response_code!~"5.*"}[5m]
          )
        )
      /
        sum(irate(istio_requests_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter="destination"}[5m]))
    )
  >
    -1
or on ()
  vector(1)
sum(irate(istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total{destination_service=~"$service",reporter=~"$qrep"}[1m]))
